# V2 wallet demonstration — approved execution

## North Star
Advertiser onboarding → historical ContextHint evidence → actual Jev advertiser bid/skip → deterministic first-price auction → disclosed publisher placement → receipt-linked synthetic accounting.

Work only in this repository. Preserve the 8792 dashboard, 18-record catalogue, travel runs and V1 payment artifacts. V2 uses port 8793, its own state and artifacts. Existing cached vectors only; uncached tasks use labelled lexical retrieval. No upstream writes, embedding generation, training, wallets, payments, deployment or push. Final frontend design is deferred.

## Frozen story
Two questions: `cheapest hardware wallet that still supports ethereum and solana` and `Compare self-custody options for Ethereum and Solana, prioritizing offline key storage over a mobile-only wallet.`

Fictional campaigns: ClearVault (hardware/offline/Ethereum/Solana), PocketKey (mobile software/Ethereum/Solana), LeatherGuard (physical RFID wallet, no crypto storage). Historical brands are references, not participants. Each has 20000 synthetic deposit, 4000 max bid and 8000 total cap in test-USDC base units.

## Gates and ownership
1. Main freezes interfaces and preservation fingerprints.
2. Evidence builder exports ≤1500 associations, ≤512 normalized prompts and ≤16 MiB; includes classification provenance and compatible existing vectors in backend-only index. Main builds dashboard in parallel.
3. Decision builder implements paired durable call admission and Jev adapter. Main integrates shared validated contracts, rules and receipts.
4. Main freezes manifest/campaign versions/policy and runs ≤12 actual calls (2 questions × 3 campaigns × 2 arms). Only history decisions enter auctions. Up to three corrective calls require a documented transport/schema defect; never retune to force winners.
5. Browser acceptance produces at least one actual disclosed accepted placement and a genuine eligible-agent skip, or documents the missing gate. Provider failures remain failures.
6. Package credential-free replay, exact runbook, captioned four-minute walkthrough and frontend contract/fixtures.
7. One fresh Sol6.1-high review; fix substantive blockers and one bounded recheck.

## Verification loop
After each lane: identify the demo beat advanced, inspect actual artifacts, run focused tests, record missing gate, choose the next integration blocker. No production-hardening expansion. A passed factual check is not full reading, attention or endorsement. The paired run is not targeting accuracy or causal lift.

## Status
Implementation started. The approved plan, not a positive model outcome, determines completion.
